status: draft-v4 (internal assistive; a human reviewer is the final authority)

defaults.perspective_preference: One-way with Amperesand Pte Ltd as the SOLE Disclosing Party and an individual (natural person) as Receiving Party — this favorable one-sidedness is INTENTIONAL: Amperesand discloses non-public business/technical information to evaluate the individual's capabilities or a defined business opportunity, and the individual is a pure recipient with no information to protect. Walk-aways flag terms that HARM Amperesand as discloser (or, in the mirror set, what to resist if a counterparty's paper flipped Amperesand into a receiver).
defaults.forum: SIAC arbitration under prevailing SIAC Rules, seat Singapore, single arbitrator, English; court carve-out for specific performance / injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction (template Clause 16 + Clause 12)
defaults.term_standard: Agreement term: 1 year from the Effective Date, terminable earlier by either Party on written notice in accordance with the notices clause (template Clause 8).
defaults.survival_standard: Template Clause 8 states each Party's rights and obligations SURVIVE termination/expiration but sets NO finite period (a drafting defect). Adopted internal default for uNDA Individual: 5 years per disclosure for ordinary Confidential Information + an uncapped trade-secret tail (protected for as long as it qualifies as a trade secret under Singapore law / applicable law), measured from the date of EACH disclosure (rolling, per-item) — NOT the Effective Date; 3-year per-disclosure pre-authorized fallback. Pending counsel refinement and a template redraft to insert the explicit finite period.
required_carveouts: prior_possession (already in the possession of or known to the Receiving Party before disclosure by the Disclosing Party)
public_domain (is or comes into the public domain through no fault or breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party)
third_party (received from a third party who is not under any obligation of confidentiality in disclosing it)
independent_development (independently developed by the Receiving Party without regard or reference to the Confidential Information)
written_authorization (approved for release or use by written authorization of the Disclosing Party)
counsel_must_confirm: Survival period: template Clause 8 says obligations survive but states NO finite period (drafting defect). Confirm adoption of the internal default (5yr per-disclosure ordinary CI + uncapped trade-secret tail, measured per disclosure; 3yr fallback) and redraft Clause 8 to insert the explicit period.

Individual enforceability realism: an individual recipient has limited assets and no insurance/indemnity backstop, so injunctive relief (Clause 12) plus the SIAC seat-Singapore forum (Clause 16) are the practical remedies; monetary recovery against a natural person is often illusory. Confirm whether to require a return/destruction certification and proactive diary of the survival tail rather than relying on after-the-fact damages.

Representatives scope for a natural person: the template's Clause 4 'authorized third party acting on behalf of the Receiving Party' should be read narrowly for an individual (e.g., the individual's own professional advisers on a strict need-to-know basis) — NOT the company-style affiliate/officer/employee universe. Confirm no entity-style group/affiliate disclosure rights are granted to the individual.

Personal data / PDPA: the CI definition (Clause 1(e)) sweeps in 'any shared personal data'. Where Amperesand shares third-party or employee personal data with the individual, confirm a PDPA-2012-aligned position (purpose limitation, reasonable security, no onward transfer, breach notice, return/deletion). Separately, the individual's OWN personal data (NRIC/passport last-four, address, email) collected in the agreement must be handled by Amperesand under the PDPA.

Pre-execution hygiene: never sign with unresolved bracketed alternative Purpose language or unfilled placeholders (Effective Date; individual's full name; NRIC/passport last-four; address; email; Attn; signatory name/title). Enforce a no-placeholders-at-signature gate.

positions.title: Definition of Confidential Information
positions.standard_position: Confidential Information is defined broadly as any and all information relating to the Purpose, disclosed/furnished/communicated in writing or orally by or on behalf of Amperesand (the Disclosing Party) to the Receiving Party (or to an authorized third party acting on the Receiving Party's behalf), which is marked 'confidential', communicated as such, OR (per the catch-all) is reasonably apparent to someone familiar with the subject area as the type typically treated as confidential, or that the Receiving Party has reason to believe may be confidential. It expressly includes (a) the existence/status of discussions and the Purpose; (b) the terms of the Agreement; (c) Amperesand's (and its Affiliates'/future subsidiaries'/portfolio companies') business, affairs, business opportunities, customers, suppliers, plans, intentions, market opportunities, IP, operations, processes, product information, know-how, technical information, designs, trade secrets and software; (d) any derived findings/data/analysis; (e) any shared personal data; (f) third-party confidential information held by Amperesand; and (g) any other information identified as confidential. NOTE the asymmetry is INTENTIONAL and correct for this type: the Affiliate-group expansion runs to AMPERESAND's group only (the individual is a natural person with no affiliates). No marking is required to qualify and there is no oral-to-writing confirmation deadline.
walk_away_triggers: Definition rewritten to be bilateral/recipient-favorable so the individual's own information is auto-deemed confidential and constrains Amperesand's use, while narrowing what Amperesand discloses — resist; on this type Amperesand is the sole protected discloser and a natural person has no confidential information to reciprocate.

Requirement that information be marked 'confidential' (or reduced to writing and marked within a fixed window) to qualify — strips protection from Amperesand's oral/visual disclosures in walkthroughs/interviews; refuse and keep the 'reasonably apparent / reason to believe' catch-all.
Definition hard-scoped to a single topic or category so Amperesand's broader shared information (financials, strategy, personnel, customers, roadmap) falls outside protection.
Deletion of the unmarked-information catch-all, or burden-of-proof-on-Disclosing-Party language, giving the individual a marking safe harbor that shrinks scope.

An individual-side affiliate/group expansion (e.g., deeming information of the individual's employer, other clients, or a company the individual is associated with as the individual's confidential information) — refuse; the only group expansion on this type is Amperesand's.
acceptable_fallbacks: A short, reasonable oral-disclosure confirmation practice (e.g., follow-up email summary) so long as failure to confirm does NOT forfeit protection.
Narrowing the enumerated categories to those actually relevant to the engagement, provided the broad opening definition and the unmarked-information catch-all are retained.

positions.title: Permitted Purpose (evaluation)
positions.standard_position: Confidential Information may be used solely for the single 'Purpose' stated in the recitals — the template Purpose is evaluating the capabilities of the Receiving Party with respect to the assessment of a business opportunity of interest to Amperesand (with the Receiving Party receiving information to demonstrate its capabilities) — and for no other purpose. The Purpose must be drafted to a single, complete definition before signing.
walk_away_triggers: Purpose expanded to permit the individual's ongoing personal or commercial use of Amperesand's information beyond the defined evaluation, without a separate definitive agreement — limit to evaluation only.

Receiving-party-controlled open-ended catch-all ('and/or such other purposes as the Receiving Party deems necessary') giving the individual unilateral latitude to expand use of Amperesand's information — strike.

Anti-reverse-engineering / design-around language buried in the purpose clause drafted broadly enough to constrain Amperesand's own legitimate engineering — narrow to genuine misappropriation of disclosed CI.

Individual publication / personal-portfolio / social-media use right over results or materials with only an advance-review window and a 'reasonable request' (not consent) removal standard — require a consent gate or remove (Clause 5 No Publicity already bars this).
Executed agreement left with unresolved bracketed alternative Purpose language or an unfilled placeholder — do not sign until the Purpose is a single, complete definition.
acceptable_fallbacks: Tightening the Purpose to name the specific business opportunity / scope of the individual's assessment — narrower is better for Amperesand as sole discloser.
Permitting the individual to disclose CI to his/her own need-to-know professional advisers strictly for the evaluation, provided the individual remains fully responsible for their compliance.

positions.title: Exclusions from Confidential Information
positions.standard_position: Five exclusions only (template Clause 2): (a) prior possession/knowledge before disclosure; (b) public domain through no fault or breach of the Receiving Party; (c) third-party receipt where the third party is not under any obligation of confidentiality; (d) independent development without regard or reference to the CI; (e) approved for release/use by written authorization of Amperesand. Compelled disclosure is handled separately as Required Disclosure (Clause 3), NOT as an exclusion.
walk_away_triggers: Public-domain carve-out drafted as 'through Receiving Party breach only', which would still bind the individual on information already public at disclosure — must read 'no fault or breach of the Receiving Party'.
Independent-development carve-out broadened so the individual can claim Amperesand's disclosed information as 'independently developed' — keep the 'without regard or reference to the CI' test tight.
Subjective/distorted carve-out tests (e.g., third-party receipt without the 'not under any obligation of confidentiality' condition) that let the individual launder CI through a friendly third party.

Addition of further recipient-favorable exclusions (e.g., 'information the Receiving Party deems non-confidential', or a residuals/unaided-memory carve-out) that erode the controlled five-exclusion set.
No compelled-disclosure mechanism at all (information neither carved out nor covered by Required Disclosure), leaving the individual unable to comply with a court/regulatory order without breaching.
acceptable_fallbacks: Reasonable documentary-proof standard requiring the Receiving Party to evidence that an exclusion applies.

A tightening of carve-out (a) — 'provided the source is not bound by a contractual obligation of confidentiality' — is Amperesand-favorable and may be added even though the individual template does not include it verbatim.

positions.title: Required Disclosure (compelled by law)
positions.standard_position: Where the Receiving Party is obligated or requested to disclose CI by a valid order of a court, governmental body or regulatory authority having jurisdiction, it must (i) give Amperesand reasonable prior written notice, (ii) disclose only such CI to the extent required, and (iii) use reasonable efforts to ensure the disclosed CI is accorded confidential treatment; if it cannot notify Amperesand before disclosure, it must, to the extent permitted by law, inform Amperesand of the full circumstances and the information disclosed as soon as reasonably practicable (template Clause 3).
walk_away_triggers: Deletion of the prior-notice / minimization / confidential-treatment mechanism, leaving the individual able to disclose Amperesand's CI under any 'request' without notice.
Shifting the cost of resisting compelled disclosure onto Amperesand as Disclosing Party as a baseline term.

Mandatory obligation requiring the individual to take 'all assistance / all steps Amperesand may require' to fight compelled disclosure where this cedes control of Amperesand's legal-process response.
acceptable_fallbacks: Notice 'to the extent legally permitted' where a gag order or statute prohibits advance notice (consistent with template Clause 3's post-hoc-notice fallback).
Adding a Singapore Exchange / regulatory-authority reference if the individual is subject to a listed-company reporting obligation.

positions.title: Confidentiality obligations of the Receiving Party
positions.standard_position: The Receiving Party must, at all times and notwithstanding termination/expiration, hold all CI in strict confidence and not disclose it to any third party without Amperesand's prior written approval, use it for no purpose other than the Purpose, apply at least the same degree of precaution it uses for its own confidential information of like importance (but in no event less than reasonable care), not copy/reduce-to-writing/record except as strictly necessary for the Purpose (any such copies/records remaining Amperesand's property), and immediately notify Amperesand upon discovery of any loss or unauthorized disclosure. For an INDIVIDUAL, any onward sharing is confined to the individual's own strictly-need-to-know professional advisers, with the individual remaining personally and fully responsible for their compliance — there is no entity/affiliate/employee disclosure universe.
walk_away_triggers: Care standard diluted below 'reasonable care', or the use-limitation ('no purpose other than the Purpose') deleted so the individual can exploit Amperesand's information for personal or other-employer purposes.

Carve-out letting the individual share Amperesand CI with an employer, other clients, a company the individual is associated with, or financing sources without a direct confidentiality obligation flowing down — refuse open-ended downstream sharing (a natural person has no affiliate group; any such expansion is a red flag).
Deletion of the immediate-notification-on-loss obligation, or of the 'copies remain Amperesand's property' provision.
AI-training / personal-tool use of Amperesand CI not prohibited, or a one-sided compliance/audit regime bolted onto the clause — refuse or scope-limit.

Prior written consent of Amperesand required before the individual may make ANY copies needed for legitimate review (impedes ordinary use) — resist; ordinary need-to-know copying for the Purpose should be permitted with copies remaining Amperesand's property.
acceptable_fallbacks: Need-to-know disclosure to the individual's own professional advisers (legal/accounting) bound by professional confidentiality, with the individual fully responsible for their breaches.
Reasonable copying strictly necessary to perform the evaluation, with all copies remaining Amperesand's property and subject to return/destruction.

positions.title: Permitted disclosures (narrow advisers and compelled)
positions.standard_position: The Receiving Party (an individual) may disclose CI only (a) to his/her own professional advisers on a strict need-to-know basis for the Purpose, with the individual remaining personally responsible for their compliance; and (b) where compelled by law per the Required Disclosure clause (with notice, minimization and confidential-treatment efforts). No other disclosure is permitted without Amperesand's prior written approval. There is NO affiliate/group/employee disclosure right — the counterparty is a natural person.
walk_away_triggers: Any entity-style disclosure right to the individual's 'affiliates', 'group', 'colleagues', 'employer', or 'financing sources' — inapplicable to a natural person and a leakage vector; refuse.
Open-ended disclosure to unidentified classes of third parties without Amperesand consent and without a flow-down obligation.
Unilateral government/regulator pass-through letting the individual disclose Amperesand CI to an agency without notice, or a standing third-party inspection right not tied to actual legal compulsion.

Requiring prior written notice to Amperesand before the individual shares with his/her OWN strictly-need-to-know adviser, where the notice requirement is not confined to that narrow adviser set (operationally awkward).
acceptable_fallbacks: Disclosure to the individual's own legal/accounting advisers bound by professional confidentiality, on a need-to-know basis for the Purpose.
Naming specific approved advisers, each subject to written confidentiality undertakings.
A requirement of prior written notice to Amperesand before the individual shares with his/her own strictly-need-to-know adviser is acceptable only if confined to that narrow adviser set.

positions.title: Survival of confidentiality obligations
positions.standard_position: The Agreement term is 1 year from the Effective Date (Clause 8), but confidentiality obligations survive termination/expiration independently. The template Clause 8 states each Party's rights and obligations survive but sets NO finite period — a drafting defect. Adopted internal default for uNDA Individual: ordinary Confidential Information protected for 5 years per disclosure (measured from the date of EACH disclosure, rolling/per-item — NOT the Effective Date), PLUS an uncapped trade-secret tail (protected for as long as it qualifies as a trade secret under Singapore / applicable law); 3-year per-disclosure pre-authorized fallback. Pending counsel refinement and template redraft.
walk_away_triggers: No post-termination survival at all, or confidentiality made co-terminous with the 1-year agreement term, leaving Amperesand's disclosed information unprotected once the short term ends.

Survival measured from the Effective Date but equal to or shorter than the agreement term, producing near-zero effective post-expiry tail (e.g., a 1-year-from-Effective-Date survival on a 1-year term yields no tail).
Removal of any trade-secret protection so Amperesand's trade secrets fall out of protection after a fixed short period.
Internally contradictory or word/numeral-mismatched survival figures (spelled-out number disagreeing with the parenthetical) — must be corrected before signature.

Perpetual / indefinite survival imposed on Amperesand only in any mirror scenario where Amperesand becomes the receiver — resist open-ended 'qualifies as confidential under applicable law' tails on Amperesand.
acceptable_fallbacks: 5 years per disclosure for ordinary CI + uncapped trade-secret tail, measured from each disclosure (the adopted internal default — the reach position).
3 years per disclosure (the established pre-authorized fallback) where 5 years cannot be secured.
Re-anchoring the period to 'from termination or expiration' rather than from the Effective Date to preserve a real post-expiry tail on a short 1-year term.

positions.title: Return or destruction of Confidential Information
positions.standard_position: Within fourteen (14) days of (i) Amperesand's written request or (ii) expiration/termination, the Receiving Party must return to Amperesand or destroy all documents and tangible materials representing Amperesand's CI and all copies, except it may retain one (1) copy (including electronic records created by automatic archiving/back-up) solely to perform surviving obligations and for so long as required by law, court, regulator, or its internal audit/compliance procedures, with the Agreement continuing to apply to any retained copy (template Clause 7).
walk_away_triggers: Retention satisfied merely by reference to the individual's own record-retention/personal-archive practice, letting the individual keep Amperesand's information indefinitely — renders the destroy obligation illusory.
Open-ended/indefinite retention of backup/archival copies with no sunset, especially negating destruction of all electronically stored CI.
Broad carve-out permitting retention of derivative materials (notes, summaries, analyses) built from Amperesand CI.
Return-only with no destruction option and no certification, forcing physical return of all electronic CI.
acceptable_fallbacks: The single archival/back-up retention copy (template-standard) limited to legal/compliance/surviving-obligation purposes, with the Agreement continuing to apply.
Destruction certification signed by the individual in lieu of physical return — recommended for an individual recipient given limited downstream verification.

positions.title: No transfer of rights, title, or interest
positions.standard_position: Amperesand retains all of its rights in its Confidential Information (including any copies or extracts) and grants no licenses or rights to any CI except those expressly set forth in the Agreement; nothing is intended to grant a license to, or waive any rights in, any patents, copyrights, trademarks or mask works belonging to Amperesand (template Clause 10).
walk_away_triggers: Any provision purporting to grant the individual an affirmative license to Amperesand's IP, or to deem disclosure an implied license or waiver of patent/copyright/trademark/mask-work rights.

Any IP-assignment or work-for-hire obligation that would only bite in a mirror scenario where Amperesand became the recipient and had to assign IP it creates — resist; carve out Amperesand's pre-existing and independently developed IP.
A patent-filing prohibition barring Amperesand from filing applications relating to information it receives (mirror scenario) — resist or narrow.

'Derived directly or indirectly' IP-capture language that could sweep in Amperesand's own innovations merely touching counterparty information (mirror scenario) — require a pre-existing/independent-development/residual-knowledge carve-out.
acceptable_fallbacks: Restating the no-license / no-waiver position mutually (harmless; the individual has no IP at stake in the typical posture).
Adding an express statement that receipt of CI does not constitute notice of any Amperesand patent under the Singapore Patents Act (Cap 221).

positions.title: No warranty / no obligation to proceed
positions.standard_position: CI is provided on a no-obligation basis: nothing compels Amperesand to supply any particular CI (Amperesand may decline at its discretion) or to enter into any transaction; no partnership, joint venture or agency is created; either Party may terminate discussions at any time (template Clause 6). Asserted defensively: CI is shared as-is with no representation or warranty by Amperesand as to accuracy, completeness or fitness, and no liability for the individual's use of or reliance on it.
walk_away_triggers: Any affirmative warranty extracted from Amperesand as to accuracy, completeness, non-infringement, fitness or performance of its disclosed information — refuse.
A no-warranty clause coupled with an indemnity by Amperesand for the individual's use of/reliance on the information — refuse (indemnity in an NDA is dealbreaker-class).

A consequential/indirect damages waiver or liability cap that limits Amperesand's recovery when the individual misuses or improperly discloses Amperesand's CI — resist; if unavoidable, carve out confidentiality breaches and IP misappropriation.
acceptable_fallbacks: Mutual as-is / no-reliance disclaimer (harmless to Amperesand as sole discloser).
Express statement that nothing obliges either Party to enter a definitive agreement (template Clause 6, already present).

positions.title: Remedies and injunctive relief
positions.standard_position: Each Party acknowledges that monetary damages alone may not be sufficient for a breach, and Amperesand (the Disclosing Party) is entitled to seek specific performance or injunctive relief from any court in any jurisdiction, in addition to all other remedies available to it (template Clause 12). No bond requirement and no cap on monetary damages. For an individual recipient (limited assets, no indemnity backstop), injunctive relief is the primary practical remedy.
walk_away_triggers: Individual extracts a pre-emptive waiver of Amperesand's right to seek injunctive/equitable relief, or a requirement that Amperesand post a bond / a nominal bond cap.
Prevailing-party attorneys'-fee shifting bolted onto remedies that asymmetrically deters Amperesand from enforcing.
Injunctive relief narrowed to IP-infringement only, excluding ordinary confidentiality breaches.
Indemnification or any liability cap bundled into the remedies clause that would limit Amperesand's recovery.
acceptable_fallbacks: Mutual injunctive-relief acknowledgment (harmless; Amperesand is the party most likely to enforce).
Express 'without posting bond or proving actual damages' language strengthening the remedy.

positions.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
positions.standard_position: Governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Singapore. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with the Agreement are referred to arbitration by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) under its prevailing rules, seat in Singapore, single arbitrator, conducted in English (template Clause 16), with the Clause 12 court carve-out for specific performance / injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction.
walk_away_triggers: Substitution of a foreign governing law and foreign-seat litigation/arbitration giving the individual a home-court advantage (e.g., the individual's home-country law and courts) — refuse or escalate.
Governing law specified but NO forum/dispute mechanism, or no governing law at all — insert Singapore law + SIAC seat Singapore.
Internally contradictory forum clause naming two incompatible institutions/seats (void-clause risk) — fix before signing.
Court litigation in the individual's home courts with prevailing-party fee-shifting — strips confidentiality/neutrality and adds asymmetric cost.
Disproportionately costly institution (e.g., ICC) for a low-value individual NDA dispute where SIAC was available.
acceptable_fallbacks: Retaining SIAC / Singapore law / single arbitrator / English (template-standard).

Neutral seat (e.g., SIAC seated Singapore) if the individual resists Singapore substantive law but accepts a neutral seat — though for an individual recipient Amperesand should hold firm on Singapore law + SIAC.

positions.title: Assignment
positions.standard_position: Neither Party may assign its rights or delegate its obligations without the other Party's prior written consent, except that Amperesand (the Disclosing Party) may (i) assign its rights and delegate its obligations to any person/entity that acquires substantially all of Amperesand's assets directly or by operation of law, and (ii) assign the Agreement to any Affiliate of Amperesand. Any purported assignment in violation is null and void; assignment does not relieve the assigning Party of its obligations; the Agreement confers no third-party-beneficiary rights (template Clause 15).
walk_away_triggers: The individual granted a reciprocal free right to assign/delegate to a third party without Amperesand consent — assignment latitude must run in Amperesand's favor only; a natural person's obligations are personal and should not be assignable at all.
Agreement made freely binding on 'successors and assigns' with no consent/notice, letting obligations or access transfer to an unknown third party.
No assignment clause at all, leaving assignment to permissive local-law defaults.
An M&A/change-of-control carve-out that restricts only Amperesand's acquirer with no equivalent constraint elsewhere.
acceptable_fallbacks: Consent-based assignment with the carve-outs running only to Amperesand (template-standard, intended one-sidedness on uNDA paper).
Confirming the individual's obligations are non-assignable/personal (appropriate for a natural person).

positions.title: Personal data / PDPA handling (individual)
positions.standard_position: Two-sided PDPA exposure for a natural-person counterparty: (1) Shared personal data is swept into the CI definition (Clause 1(e)) — where Amperesand shares third-party/employee personal data with the individual, the individual must process it only for the Purpose, apply reasonable security, not transfer it onward without consent, notify Amperesand of any data breach, and return/delete it on request or termination, consistent with the PDPA 2012. (2) The individual's OWN personal data (NRIC/passport last-four, address, email) collected in the agreement must be handled by Amperesand as data controller under the PDPA — collected, used and retained only for the NDA's purpose and protected with reasonable security.
walk_away_triggers: Individual seeks rights to use any shared personal data for personal purposes, marketing, model-training, or onward transfer outside Singapore without PDPA-compliant safeguards.
No breach-notification obligation on the individual for personal-data incidents involving Amperesand-shared data.

A clause requiring the individual to disclose more personal identifiers than the template's last-four NRIC/passport standard, or to consent to broad secondary uses of his/her personal data by Amperesand or third parties — refuse; keep collection minimal per PDPA.
Individual disclaims any responsibility for personal data he/she receives while still receiving it.
acceptable_fallbacks: Relying on the general CI obligations to cover shared personal data where no material personal data is exchanged (the template's default — Clause 1(e) folds personal data into CI).

A short PDPA processing addendum scoped to the specific personal data shared (security, no-onward-transfer, breach-notice, deletion), plus a brief PDPA consent/notification for the individual's own identifiers.

positions.title: Notices and miscellaneous boilerplate
positions.standard_position: Notices effective on delivery by hand, email, or certified/registered mail to the specified addresses (template Clause 9). Clean boilerplate: no-publicity (Clause 5), waiver (Clause 11), severability (Clause 13), counterparts and PDF/e-signature execution recognized as valid secure electronic signatures (Clause 17, consistent with the Electronic Transactions Act 2010 of Singapore). No prevailing-party fee-shifting and no extra regulatory/compliance obligations.
walk_away_triggers: Attorneys'-fee / prevailing-party fee-shifting clause inserted (not in Amperesand's template) — resist or strike.

Incomplete or blank notice/signature details (placeholder full name, NRIC/passport last-four, address, email, Attn, signatory title) left in the executed agreement, undermining valid service and identification of the individual — never sign with placeholder fields.
US-litigation-specific boilerplate (e.g., jury-trial waiver) inserted into a Singapore-governed agreement where it is inapplicable — strike.
A 'Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)' provision drafted to CONFER enforcement rights on third parties — keep it as an EXCLUSION of third-party rights, not a grant.
Perpetual/unlimited-in-time survival of miscellaneous obligations — cap to a defined term consistent with the survival position.
acceptable_fallbacks: Adding a Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act exclusion clause ('a person who is not a party has no right to enforce any term') — Amperesand-neutral/favorable.
Updating notice addressees/emails to current Amperesand contacts.

positions.title: Entire agreement and amendments
positions.standard_position: The Agreement is the final, complete and exclusive agreement of the Parties on its subject matter, superseding and merging all prior discussions; no modification or amendment is effective unless in writing and signed by authorized representatives of the Parties (template Clause 14).
walk_away_triggers: Carve-out letting the individual's prior correspondence or separate terms override the NDA.
Oral or unilateral amendment permitted, weakening the written-and-signed requirement.
acceptable_fallbacks: Standard merger + written-amendment clause (template-standard).

positions.title: Non-solicitation (prohibited in NDA)
positions.standard_position: Amperesand's SG Individual uNDA template contains NO non-solicitation covenant; an NDA is a confidentiality instrument, not a trade-restraint vehicle. An inserted non-solicit is treated as a prohibited, high-severity clause. (For a natural person such a restraint also raises Singapore enforceability concerns absent a legitimate proprietary interest and reasonable scope.)
walk_away_triggers: Any standalone non-solicitation covenant (employees, customers or suppliers) untethered from use of CI.
Non-solicit binding only the individual with no fixed term / perpetual restraint, or exceeding 12 months.
Liquidated-damages or indemnity tied to a non-solicit breach.
acceptable_fallbacks: If genuinely required, a narrow, use-tethered non-solicit of directly-involved personnel, capped at 12 months, with a general-advertising / non-targeted-recruiting carve-out — documented as a concession, not Amperesand-standard, and reviewed for Singapore enforceability against a natural person.

positions.title: Non-competition (prohibited in NDA)
positions.standard_position: Amperesand's SG Individual uNDA template contains NO non-competition clause; the preferred position is no non-compete, no non-compete-taint/contamination restriction, and no non-compete waiver in either direction. A non-compete against a natural person also raises acute Singapore restraint-of-trade enforceability concerns.
walk_away_triggers: Any non-compete or personnel-'taint' restriction imposed on Amperesand barring Amperesand personnel exposed to the individual's information from working on competing technology — a de facto non-compete on Amperesand's teams.
Any actual restraint on the individual competing or on Amperesand competing, embedded in the NDA.
An exclusivity demand barring Amperesand from engaging others for the same opportunity during/after evaluation.
acceptable_fallbacks: None as Amperesand-standard. Any restraint belongs in a separate engagement/employment agreement subject to Singapore reasonableness review, not the NDA.

positions.title: Indemnification (prohibited in NDA)
positions.standard_position: Amperesand's SG Individual uNDA template contains NO indemnification, hold-harmless or fee-shifting provision; confidentiality breaches are remedied through general-law damages and equitable relief (Clause 12). The preferred position is to strike any indemnity or attorneys'-fees clause entirely.
walk_away_triggers: Any indemnity running against Amperesand (especially uncapped, or on a solicitor-client/indemnity-basis costs standard).
Indemnity/liability extending to 'attempted or threatened' disclosure.
Any non-mutual fee-shifting or indemnity running only in the individual's favor.
acceptable_fallbacks: If unavoidable, a mutual, capped indemnity limited to confidentiality breaches, excluding indirect/consequential loss — documented as a concession, not Amperesand-standard (and recognizing an individual's indemnity is often of limited practical value).
